$comment: Every route of the web application declares its kind and its surface here (ADR-28, ADR-02). A page that is not listed fails `pnpm verify:build` and the header tests. The routes of a test build (--dev-pages) are declared with the dev fixtures, so that not even their names are in a production build. `answeredByTheProxy` are paths the proxy answers itself, without a page: the form's POST path for a Send pressed before its scripts arrived (UX-M1-03).
